hook: Aadhi raat ko pokhar se Dadi ki roti hui aawaaz aayi!
feedback: Solid structure and emotional depth. The twist lands remarkably well. To tighten further: ensure Cut 7 (silent entity insert) moves at lightning speed so it doesn't drag the visual pacing down before the high-tension reveal. Dialogue and narrator split are balanced nicely. LENGTH: about 84s; it must be 40-55s (roughly 80-110 spoken words). REPEATS: an image is reused too often or twice in a row; use new inserts (hands, eyes, lantern, a clue) instead.
lines: Aadhi raat ko pokhar se Dadi ki roti hui aawaaz aayi!
Par ye khauf shuru hua theek bees minute pehle...
Mithila ke Simri gaon mein, Babu apni bimar Dadi ki dawa lene nikla tha.
Raaste mein purana pokhar tha, jise sab shraapit kehte the.
Babu... bacha le Babu... bahut thand hai yahan...
Babu saham gaya... aawaaz bilkul uski Dadi ki thi!
Gaon ka niyam tha— agar teen baar jawab diya, toh pokhar kheench lega.
Usne do baar pukara, 'Dadi? Dadi tum?'
Jaise hi wo teesri baar bolne laga, paani se bhayanak saaya ubhra!
Peeche sach mein uski Dadi khadi theen, thartharate haathon se use pakde hue.
Dadi ne apna purana taaviz paani mein phenk diya!
Ek cheekh ke saath pokhar ka saaya dhuen mein badal gaya.
Babu ki nazar zameen par padi... Dadi ki koi parchhai nahi thi.
Dadi sham ko hi guzar chuki theen, bas apne Babu ko bachane aayi theen.
Kyunki us raat, pokhar se Dadi ne nahi... maut ne pukara tha.
